ns2:course.label: Computational Complexity
ns2:course.description: (ECE 479) Turing machines; determinism and non-determinism; time and space hierarchy theorems; speed-up and tape compression; Blum axioms; structure of complexity classes NP, P, NL, L, PSPACE; complete problems; randomness and complexity classes RP, RL, BPP; alternation, polynomial-time hierarchy; circuit complexity, parallel complexity, NC, RNC; relativized computational complexity; time-space trade-offs. Same as CS 579 and MATH 578. Prerequisite: CS 473 or CS 475 or consent of instructor
